s: This video is a 33-second promotional trailer for a television broadcast hosted by Dr. Francis Myles. It advertises a series on the Order of Melchizedek covering kingdom prosperity and breaking generational curses.

t: The Priesthood of All Believers | FMCO Sunday Service | Dr. Francis & Carmela Myles
s: Dr. Francis Myles teaches that Jesus abolished the exclusive Levitical priesthood to restore all believers as royal priests under the Order of Melchizedek. He argues that functioning as a priest requires enduring hardship to develop empathy and maintaining strict consecration according to God's exact instructions.

t: Kingdom Invasion in the Marketplace Part 3 | Ep. 15 | The Word Network
s: Believers are called to operate under the Melchizedek priesthood as both kings and priests, turning their marketplace businesses into altars for kingdom advancement and reaching people by providing divine strategies to resolve their practical and financial struggles.
r: Genesis 14 · Luke 5:1-11

t: Operating as a King and Priest Part 2 | Ep. 12 | The Word Network
s: Every believer is called to operate in the Melchizedek priesthood by guarding biblical knowledge, advocating for others through intercession, and maintaining personal and family altars.
r: Hebrews 4 · Hebrews 5 · Hebrews 7 · Hebrews 8 · 1 Peter 2:9 · Malachi 2:7 · Hebrews 5:1 · Numbers 18:5

t: Operating as a King and Priest Part 1 | Ep. 11 | The Word Network
s: An understanding of how the Order of Melchizedek unites the offices of king and priest, granting believers spiritual authority to take territory and dominate secular spheres in the marketplace.
r: Genesis 12 · Genesis 14 · Revelation 1:5-6 · Hebrews 5 · Hebrews 6 · Hebrews 7 · Genesis 1:11

t: The Gospel of the Kingdom Part 1 | Ep. 9 | The Word Network
s: Francis Myles teaches that believers are called to operate as priest-kings under the Melchizedek order to establish God's rule on earth, rather than passively waiting to escape to heaven. True spiritual power comes from stewarding earthly dominion and bringing heavenly realities into everyday life and nations.

t: Tithing Under the Order of Melchizedek Part 4 | Ep. 8 | The Word Network
s: Dr Francis Myles argues that tithing belongs under the Melchizedek priesthood rather than the Old Testament law of Malachi. Under this model, believers tithe because they are already blessed in Christ, which creates a spiritual altar that activates prophetic promises and allows Jesus in heaven to receive their gifts.

t: We are a Royal Priesthood
s: An explanation of why the phrase 'royal priesthood' in 1 Peter 2:9 signaled to Jewish believers a shift away from the Aaronic order into the Melchizedek priesthood.
r: 1 Peter 2:9 · Galatians

t: Tithing Under the Order of Melchizedek Part 3 | Ep. 7 | The Word Network
s: Francis Myles argues that tithing under the Order of Melchizedek is superior to the Old Testament Levitical system found in Malachi. He asserts that Melchizedek tithing operates by grace from inside the kingdom to open doors of favor and pass down generational blessings.

t: Tithing Under the Order of Melchizedek Part 2 | Ep. 6 | The Word Network
s: Dr. Francis Myles teaches that tithing under the Order of Melchizedek is not designed to generate wealth, but to legally authorize God to provide divine interception against unseen spiritual attacks. He argues that interception stops destruction before it arrives, whereas divine intervention only rescues people after damage has already occurred.
